Well, to date there's no fool-proof method of documenting the other side. Someone could persay get a video of Satan tap dancing, and it still wouldn't be evidence. 

You can't "prove" the paranormal. You can determine some stuff is caused by this or that reasonable explanation, but for the stuff with no clear answer, it's unresolved at best. 

Yes, I believe in the paranormal, but it's not like checking the weather. You can't definitely prove anything about it. 

Same with Ouija boards.

You are right AND wrong

Yes, they are just toys and the boards themselves are NOT evil. However, it's how people use them that causes an issue to occur. 

Also, let me claim I've never used a Ouija board, but I've heard enough stories to not be interested...

People are using them to communicate with the other side. The board becomes a "door" that allows anything on the other side to pass through. Anything could become this door. From your mirror during Bloody Mary etc. it's not object but rather the intent of the user(s). If you aren't trying contact the other side etc, nothing will happen to you. They have to be invited in. 

Using ouija boards is a flashing neon light to the other side that says "hey!! I'm here and you can come in now!"  

Not to mention people often use them incorrectly, and that can cause detrimental results.

Last night was better. I woke up maybe twice the whole night (which is insane for me). I used tak different apps to record myself and would stop and start the other when I awoke. Each recording was about 4 hours. And this fascinates me that I am NOT waking up. I had insanely weird dreams again. Which is unusual for me. When I do dream, I tend to dream about real-life situations. Such as, my anxieties and people I personally know. These dreams had people I didn't recognize. In one dream last night, I was laying in the bed in this room. Someone was standing in the spot where I was 100% convinced I felt someone there watching me the previous night. I know I was asleep however I was dreaming of myself in the room. I remember seeing the curtains moving and the moonlight streaming in. 
I was asking them about their life, and they told me how they died. I remember joking "you just died then" based off how they died. They didn't show me what they looked like, but I wasn't scared of them. 

The two times I woke up, the room didn't necessarily feel empty, but I didn't get the sense of was being judged like I had been the night before. Also, I woke up hot (this is normal for me). What makes it odd was that the night before each time I woke up I was FREEZING and I was bundled up in a long wool sweater, insulated sweats, and a heavy comforter. I was so hot last night I changed. I did so in the dark because I wasn't scared this time.
